title: The minimality inequality propagates from a neighbourhood of spt(S − T) to larger open sets
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) integer multiplicity, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact with spt(S − T) ⊆ K, and W, W' ⊆ ℝ^P open with K ⊆ W ⊆ W' and closure(W') compact and contained in U. If M_W(T) ≤ M_W(S), then M_{W'}(T) ≤ M_{W'}(S).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (K W W' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsCompact K → (S - T).support ⊆ K → IsOpen W → IsOpen W' → K ⊆ W → W ⊆ W' → CompactlyContained W' U → T.massOn W ≤ S.massOn W → T.massOn W' ≤ S.massOn W'
